summary: Partners Group Lending Fund, LLC filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026 disclosing that its newly formed subsidiary, PG BDC Finance II, LLC, entered a Loan and Servicing Agreement on September 18, 2026, creating a secured credit facility. SMBC is Administrative and Collateral Agent; State Street is Account Bank, Collateral Custodian and Collateral Administrator. Committed amount is $75 million plus $175 million uncommitted, with an accordion to $1 billion; a 36-month reinvestment period precedes a September 1 maturity. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
